state:
Goal `core-os-and-2-more`: `Core\Os::cpuCount` and `Core\Os::hostname` have all their feature proofs on disk: about, three examples each, an attack, a bench and a Rust `covers:` marker.
`Core\Os` now has its class card, and it is off `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`. The member cards of `cpuCount`, `hostname` and `loadAverage` were rewritten in the plain voice.
`loadAverage` already carries its Rust `covers:` marker on `load_average_throws_on_windows_with_a_message_naming_the_platform`. It still owes about, examples, hostile and perf.
Every value in `Core\Os` differs per machine, so each example prints a check (`yes`, `100`) and never the value itself.

items.text: **`Core\Os::loadAverage`** — owes about, examples, hostile, perf (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/os.rs:93`. It throws a `RuntimeError` on Windows. An example that reads the figures needs `// requires: unix` and is blessed on Linux (`docs/examples/README.md` § *`// requires: unix`*). An example that catches the throw and prints the same line on both platforms runs everywhere. The attack and the bench must survive both platforms: catch the throw in each step, and let the bench total count a throw as 0.

backlog: Uint division: `uint / uint` is typed `uint|float` and `Core\Math::intDiv` takes `int` only, so an example dividing a `uint` count uses `%` or a loop. No doc owns this yet.
